zh-CN.title: 聊天记录搜索更稳定
items: 修复搜索聊天记录 Drawer 打开后闪退的问题
搜索页现在按层级返回聊天详情，选择结果后直接定位消息
背景、气泡与头像框支持按解锁等级或品质分组
新增全部、已拥有、未拥有筛选，快速定位可用装扮
装扮名称直接使用品质色，不再重复标注品质名称

en.title: More reliable message search
items: Fixed the message search drawer closing immediately after opening
Search now returns through chat details and jumps directly to a selected message
Group backgrounds, bubbles, and avatar frames by unlock level or rarity
Filter the library by all, owned, or not owned items
Item names now carry their rarity color without redundant rarity labels
